description: Send EU B2B invoices (VAT ID, net amount, date, country, optional VAT amount and kind L / S / D) and get the Zusammenfassende Meldung (EC Sales List): one line per buyer VAT ID and kind in full euro, the BZSt Mein BOP CSV import file as base64, each VAT ID checked live at the European Commission VIES (with requesterVat VIES returns the consultation number as proof) and the audit risks (0 % VAT without VAT ID, wrong check digit, VIES invalid, VAT charged on reverse charge, domestic VAT ID). Up to 50 invoices / 25 VAT IDs per call. 0 AI, nothing stored. Free: 5 calls/day per IP. Paid: Radar API key (from €15/mo at https://radarbg.com/pricing#starter via X-API-Key) or $0.01/call via x402 at https://radarbg.com/x402/eu-zm-report.

homeCountry.description: Your country code (sales with a VAT ID from it are domestic)

orders.description: Invoices: [{invoiceNumber, date (YYYY-MM-DD), country, vatId, netAmount, currency (EUR), taxAmount, supplyType (L/S/D)}]. Empty = built-in sample of 10 invoices

period.description: all, latest_q, latest_m or a quarter like 2026-Q4

requesterVat.description: Your own EU VAT ID, e.g. DE123456789: VIES then returns a consultation number per buyer

viesCheck.description: false = format and check digit only, no VIES call

name: eu_zm_report
title: EU ZM / EC Sales List API - BZSt CSV, VIES proof with consultation numbers and audit risks
